# Condition-based maintenance in European industry: findings

## Reliability does not scale with maintenance spend

Across 214 plants surveyed by Fraunhofer IPA in 2025, the top quartile by scheduled-maintenance spend lost 11 percent more production hours to unplanned stops than the bottom quartile [Source: Fraunhofer IPA](https://www.ipa.fraunhofer.de/de/publikationen/instandhaltung-2025.html). Scheduled work replaces components on a calendar; the components that were actually failing were in most cases not the ones being replaced.

## The signal exists and is not read

In the same sample, 62 percent of unplanned stops had a measurable precursor in sensor data at least 48 hours before failure. In 71 percent of those cases the data existed in a plant system but was not read by anyone [Source: Fraunhofer IPA](https://www.ipa.fraunhofer.de/de/publikationen/instandhaltung-2025.html). Plants that convert their signals into one asset-health view report 34 percent fewer unplanned stops.

## Format fragmentation is the practical barrier

A typical plant produces 47 distinct sensor data formats across drives, bearings, pumps and control systems. Monitoring products on the market read between 8 and 12 of them; the remaining formats are the long tail where roughly 60 percent of failure signals originate [Source: VDMA](https://www.vdma.org/condition-monitoring-studie-2025).

## Labour is leaving

Destatis projects a 23 percent decline in qualified industrial maintenance technicians in Germany between 2025 and 2030 [Source: Destatis](https://www.destatis.de/DE/Themen/Arbeit/Arbeitsmarkt/Erwerbstaetigkeit/instandhaltung-2030.html). The wage premium for the remaining technicians rose 18 percent between 2023 and 2025 [Source: Handelsblatt](https://www.handelsblatt.com/unternehmen/industrie/instandhaltung-fachkraefte-2025).

## Costs per incident

The sample average cost of one lost production hour is 180,000 euros; the average plant loses 24 production hours per year to unplanned stops [Source: Fraunhofer IPA](https://www.ipa.fraunhofer.de/de/publikationen/instandhaltung-2025.html). A condition-based programme for a mid-sized operator with 40 critical assets costs about 4.2 million euros over three years including integration, documentation and the operating-model change; a compliance retrofit under deadline pressure costs 1.4 million euros against 0.6 million for a planned programme [Source: VDMA](https://www.vdma.org/condition-monitoring-studie-2025).
